acceptance.continue_to_trace: The existing GLM NextN/MTP path can produce ordered expert-address candidates for every routed target layer over K >= 2 future tokens before reading or computing those target tokens' routed experts.
acceptance.stop_before_engine_work: Future target-layer expert IDs become available only while executing those target layers, or obtaining them requires target routed-expert reads/verification whose union grows with K.

forbidden_evidence: Do not inspect or score the prohibited partial candidate-18 held-out captures.
Do not rerun, replace, or complete the terminal held-out P1 experiment.
Do not claim address-oracle value from acceptance-speculation speed or token acceptance alone.
measurement_fallback: Only if source inspection is genuinely ambiguous, run one contained glm_safe_run.sh trace on already-open training/precision fixtures. It must count target expert bytes, MTP bytes, route-availability time, and lead time. No held-out value may be opened.

physics.rationale: An address oracle must reveal target-layer expert IDs before the corresponding target routed-expert bytes are consumed; otherwise it cannot create NVMe overlap and merely moves or duplicates the same I/O.

review_requirement: Both persistent reviewers independently trace data/control flow in the readable compiled source. Any critical/high correctness objection blocks disposition; agreement that the stop condition is structurally met ends Rung 0.5 without a GPU run.
